failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remaining above their current levels or continuing to recover.

mechanism_narrative: The current gap between WORKPLACES and TRANSIT matters: if WORKPLACES stabilizes or rises while TRANSIT remains suppressed, retail growth will stay muted because commuting activity is not converting into commercial footfall, leaving RETAIL_REC below its recent average over four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL continues to rise while WORKPLACES falls, it signals stronger stay-at-home behavior that will reduce discretionary shopping trips within one week and push RETAIL_REC downward relative to the last month.
